scenicChapters.title: Adriatic Highway, Jadranska Magistrala
scenicChapters.narrative: The valley floor is behind you and the road starts working for its height at about 35.9%. Corners stack above one another where the ground allows nothing straighter — first and second gear more often than not. Look through each corner to the next one and let the engine do the holding.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

scenicChapters.title: Adriatic Highway, Jadranska Magistrala
scenicChapters.narrative: 926 m come off over 18 km at around 9.1%. The road gives back what the climb took, faster than it took it. Brakes early, eyes far ahead. A descent this long asks more of concentration than of pace.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

montenegro-bay-of-kotor-serpentine.story: 30 km one way from Kotor - plan on about 32 min of riding. On the way it passes Kotor Serpentine and Krstac Pass. The highest point is about 950 m. It suits an unhurried touring pace.
